items.title: 维护者能从 typed runtime registry 查看环境事实分级
items.context: 新增 runtime/environment fact registry，描述 CLI entrypoint、global core realpath、local project bin、Node version、package version、validate entrypoint、external service reference 这些非流程但会影响跨项目使用的事实。分级要区分 hard/warn/advisory，不能和 process fact registry 混成一张表。
items.userSees: 打开 `packages/main/src/core/runtime-fact-registry.ts` 时能看到 runtime fact IDs、severity、scope、checker、expected output key 和 drift message；运行 doctor JSON 时能看到同名 runtime facts 分区。

happy.desc: runtime fact registry 明确列出 cli-entrypoint/global-core-realpath/project-local-bin/node-version/package-version/validate-source/external-reference-policy，并包含 severity/scope/checker/outputKey。

edge.desc: runtime facts 与 process facts 分域：process-fact contract 仍只管流程事实，runtime registry 不把 CLI entrypoint 伪装成 gate artifact。

adversarial.desc: 删除 required runtime fact（如 project-local-bin 或 validate-source）时 runtime contract 失败并点名 missing runtime fact。

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:runtime-fact-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Build passed and runtime contract verified required registry facts, output keys, and typed metadata.
Process fact contract passed with runtime environment facts kept out of process-fact-registry.
Runtime contract fails with Runtime fact contract failed and names missing required facts/output keys; normal run verified all required facts.

items.title: 维护者能运行 runtime 检查发现 Koala 入口漂移
items.context: 新增或扩展 CLI 检查，让 command -v koala、npm root -g 下的 @koala-agent/core realpath、当前 worktree packages/main、项目 node_modules/.bin/koala 是否覆盖 global 这些事实被机器检查。Orchestrate 自身应 hard fail/warn 明确，外部项目至少 warning 并给出修复命令。
items.userSees: 运行 `koala doctor --format=json` 时，输出 `runtime` 分区展示 `cliEntrypoint`、`globalCoreRealpath`、`projectLocalBin` 等 actual/expected/status；若项目本地 bin 覆盖或 global core 不匹配，会显示 warn/fail 和修复提示。

happy.desc: 在 Orchestrate 本仓运行 koala doctor --format=json，runtime section 显示 global @koala-agent/core realpath 指向 packages/main，cli entrypoint resolved，状态 pass。

edge.desc: 在临时项目中放置 node_modules/.bin/koala 覆盖入口时，runtime checker 输出 project-local-bin warning，并给出检查/移除提示，不误判为流程 gate 失败。

adversarial.desc: 模拟 global core realpath 与当前 expected core 不一致时，Orchestrate/self-check 模式输出 hard failure 或明确 warning，不能静默 pass。

verificationEvidence.note: Contract smoke exercised doctor JSON runtime output for cliEntrypoint/globalCoreRealpath/projectLocalBin and all required output keys.
Runtime checker reports project-local-bin as warn-level runtime drift and keeps it outside process gates.
Type-checked self/external severity split so self project realpath drift can fail while external projects remain warn/advisory.

items.title: 维护者能发现 validate fallback 和外部 service/memory 漂移风险
items.context: doctor 当前只 advisory 展示 validation fallback；把 validate source 和 external service/memory reference 健康检查纳入 runtime registry 输出。第一版外部 service 可以先做配置/文档引用的结构化提醒，不需要真的连接所有服务，但如果事实被 gate/evidence 消费必须标 hard。
items.userSees: koala doctor text/json 展示 validate-source runtime fact；external-reference-policy 只扫描 koala.config.json、AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、README.md、docs/requirements/**/*.md，排除 .koala/story、docs/story、tests/fixtures、node_modules、dist/build 和普通源码注释；localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 默认 internal example，不报外部漂移；非本地 URL/host:port 缺少 health check / health command 语义时输出 health-check-required/reference-only warning，不输出 connectivity pass。

happy.desc: doctor text/json 均展示 validate-source runtime fact，并区分 configured validate command 与 advisory fallback discovery。

edge.desc: external-reference-policy 只扫描 bounded truth/config surfaces，排除 story/fixture/build/node_modules/source-comment 噪音；localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 internal examples 不触发外部漂移 warning。
扫描到非本地 service/memory 风格引用但没有 health command 语义时，输出 health-check-required/reference-only warning，不输出 connectivity pass。

adversarial.desc: 当 validate.ts/js/mts 与 validate.command(s) 都缺失且没有 fallback 时，runtime checker 给出 missing/no-validator warning 和修复建议。
外部引用 checker 不允许把仅存在 URL/host:port 的文件标成 connectivity pass；只有显式 health command 语义才能从 policy warning 升级。

verificationEvidence.note: Validation protocol smoke asserted doctor JSON runtime.validateSource exists and doctor text contains Runtime scan plus Validation scan.
Runtime checker bounded external-reference-policy to docs/config surfaces and reports connectivityChecked=false policy-only output.
External references without health semantics stay reference-only warnings; localhost/internal examples are ignored by checker logic.
validate-source checker type-checked missing/fallback states as warnings with repair hint for validate.ts/js/mts or configured commands.
Contract asserted external-reference-policy actual.policy is reference-only and connectivityChecked is false, preventing false connectivity pass.

items.title: runtime registry 与检查逻辑有 contract 测试防回退
items.context: 新增验证脚本或扩展 process-fact contract，确保 runtime registry 的事实项、checker 输出字段、doctor/env_check 暴露命令保持一致；人为删除 CLI entrypoint/local-bin/validate-source fact 时测试要失败并点名缺失。
items.userSees: 运行 `npm run test:runtime-fact-contract` 时，正常输出 `Runtime fact contract verified`；缺失 fact 或 checker output key 时输出 `Runtime fact contract failed:` 并点名缺失的 fact/output key。

happy.desc: npm run test:runtime-fact-contract 输出 Runtime fact contract verified，并列出 runtime fact IDs 与 doctor runtime output keys 对齐。

edge.desc: runtime contract 能验证 doctor --format=json 暴露 runtime section，且 text 输出也包含 Runtime scan 分区。

adversarial.desc: 人为删除 required runtime fact 或 checker output key 时，contract 失败并点名 missing runtime fact / missing runtime output key。

verificationEvidence.note: Runtime fact contract verified all required IDs and aligned runtime output keys.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run test:runtime-fact-contract && npm --prefix packages/main run test:validation-protocol
verificationEvidence.note: Contract and validation smoke asserted doctor JSON runtime section and text Runtime scan section.
Contract implementation emits Runtime fact contract failed and names missing runtime fact/output key when required registry/output coverage is removed.
